diffs.diff: pin count: part has 6 (IN2 IN1 VM GND OUT2 OUT1), datasheet reading has 4 (IN2 IN1 VM GND)
diffs.evidence: The second reading lists only the 4-pin 0.1in header (IN2 IN1 VM GND) and leaves out the motor outputs. The Adafruit #3190 pinouts page has a separate 'Motor Output' section: 'Pretty simple - this is where your motor goes!' (the MOTOR screw terminal), and says 'IN2 goes to OUT2, IN1 goes to OUT1'. The TI DRV8871 datasheet pin table lists 'OUT1 6 O H-bridge output - Connect directly to the motor or other inductive load' and 'OUT2 8'. So OUT1/OUT2 are real connections on the board's MOTOR terminal. The model marks them required=false and describes them as screw-terminal pins, which is correct.
